plan.title: Event moves to History after PO creation

steps.note: Create a controlled event for the list transition test.
Give the event a known title for later list searches.
Use an RFQ stage so the event can receive a bid and be awarded.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the required purchasable line item.
Complete the pricing sheet before publishing.
Commit a valid bidding schedule.
Provide a participant so the event can be published and receive a bid.
Publish the event into the Live state.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Have the invited QA vendor submit the bid needed for awarding.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Return to the events list to verify the pre-award location.
Open the Live tab before awarding.
Assert the event is present in Live before awarding.
Reopen the event to close bidding and complete the award.
Close the bidding window so the event can be awarded.
Award the event to the vendor that submitted the portal bid.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the award to completion and create the purchase order.
Confirm the created PO contains the awarded line item.
Return to the events list after PO creation.
Check that the event has left Live.
Assert the event is no longer listed in Live.
Open History to find the completed event.
Assert the event is listed in History after PO creation.
Assert the History row shows the awarded status.
